# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-C: Scripted Triggers (0 bare if/else) (oe_qol_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_qol_mp.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Strictly human non-rebel realms (zero AI overhead).
oe_qol_human_realm = {
	is_ai = no
	is_rebel_country = no
}

# Country scope. True ONLY when a human player explicitly opted into at least one QoL/MP feature.
oe_qol_any_opt_in = {
	OR = {
		var:oe_qol_marriage_on ?= 1
		var:oe_qol_tutor_on ?= 1
		var:oe_qol_mp_compact_on ?= 1
		has_variable = oe_qol_rgo_runs
		has_variable = oe_qol_road_runs
	}
}

# Character scope. Eligible unmarried adult noble/dynastic courtier aged 18-35 (never ruler/heir/clergy).
oe_qol_marriage_candidate = {
	is_alive = yes
	is_adult = yes
	age_in_years >= 18
	age_in_years <= 35
	is_ruler = no
	is_heir = no
	is_married = no
	has_available_marriage_slot = yes
	is_eligible_for_marriage = yes
	NOT = { has_trait = eunuch }
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
	OR = {
		has_dynasty = yes
		has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
	}
}

# Character scope. Royal heir or dynastic child aged 3-15 without a child education assigned yet.
oe_qol_tutor_candidate = {
	is_alive = yes
	is_adult = no
	age_in_years >= 3
	age_in_years <= 15
	has_child_education_selected = no
	OR = {
		is_heir = yes
		has_dynasty = yes
	}
}

# Location scope (root = country). Owned core non-besieged location whose RGO is not maxed out.
oe_qol_rgo_upgrade_candidate = {
	has_siege = no
	is_core_of = root
	is_full_expanded_rgo = no
}

# Country scope. True if country has unlocked at least one vanilla or imperial road type.
oe_qol_has_any_road_tech = {
	OR = {
		road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root }
		road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root }
	}
}

# Location scope (root = country). High-population regional hub, town/city, market center, or capital ring
# lacking the latest unlocked road to an adjacent owned capital/capital-linked/high-control anchor.
oe_qol_trunk_hub_candidate = {
	has_siege = no
	has_road_constructions = no
	is_core_of = root
	OR = {
		is_market_center = yes
		location_rank = location_rank:town
		location_rank = location_rank:city
		location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
		population >= 10
		any_neighbor_location = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner ?= root
			is_capital = yes
		}
	}
	any_neighbor_location = {
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= root
		has_siege = no
		has_road_constructions = no
		OR = {
			is_capital = yes
			has_road_to_capital = yes
			is_market_center = yes
			local_control >= 0.55
		}
		NOT = { has_latest_road_to = prev }
	}
}

# Any/Country scope. True when running in a multiplayer lobby or with multiple connected players.
oe_qol_mp_is_multiplayer = {
	OR = {
		is_multiplayer_session = yes
		has_multiple_players = yes
	}
}
